latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cloudflare-workers-architect.  
- Helps design end-to-end Cloudflare Workers solutions, selecting the optimal runtime (Workers, Pages, Durable Objects, Workers AI) and storage (KV, D1, R2, Durable Objects, Hyperdrive).
- Covers advanced architecture needs: real-time state patterns, queue pipelines, cron triggers, Tail Workers, Smart Placement, AI model selection, Vectorize embeddings, legacy database access, and migration strategies from Lambda@Edge, Vercel Edge, and Deno Deploy.
- Provides workload classification decision trees, storage selection matrices, and architecture anti-pattern guidance.
- Outputs actionable artifacts: primitive choices, wrangler.toml config, binding declarations, code skeletons, deploy scripts, and a cost projection.
- Designed for both architecture planning and debugging within the Cloudflare developer ecosystem.
